title: 1989-90 Fred Hatfield Parade Marshall for Spud and Spoke Days
description: In 1989, Fred Hatfield served as the parade marshal during the Covered Bridge Spud and Spoke Days. The Hartland Potato Festival received its new name after a contest was held among Hartland school students. Tyson Craig earned a $50 prize for his winning suggestion.
